title: pkix-identity IdentityError retains dead NotYetImplemented variant
description:
In pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:347, IdentityError::NotYetImplemented is documented as 'Retained for API compatibility but no longer returned by any function in this crate.' Since the crate is pre-1.0 and the enum is #[non_exhaustive], removing dead variants is a semver-valid change.

What goes wrong: The dead variant is noise in the documentation and in exhaustive match arms callers write for this type. The AGENTS.md says 'breaking changes are free' pre-1.0 and this is the mechanism for getting the design right.

Location: pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:347

Recommendation: Remove NotYetImplemented in the next 0.x release. The pre-1.0 semver window is exactly when this cleanup should happen.
